notes: Read from the Ohio Department of Taxation Optional Computer Formula, Rev. 07/26, effective August 1, 2026, on 2026-10-18 (the PDF text layer is unreadable, so the figures were read from the rendered page): TW = annual pay - $650 per exemption; up to $26,050 withholding = TW x 1.600%; $26,050-$100,000 = $416.80 + 2.990% of the excess over $26,050; over $100,000 = $2,627.91 + 3.400% of the excess over $100,000.
These are withholding rates, not Ohio's statutory income tax rate. Payrolls ending before 2026-08-01 used earlier tables (Oct 1, 2025). The calculator uses the current tables for the whole year.
Ohio municipal and school district income taxes are not included unless the visitor enters a local rate.
No official worked example is published with the formula; golden tests are hand-computed from it.

Sign-off recorded 2026-10-18 on the owner's instruction, after the numbers were compared with the sources listed in this file. Editorial text in src/lib/states.ts and any limits listed above were not independently reviewed.
